# 3alamiy Web3 — Crypto Airdrop Tracker & GM Station

## What is 3alamiy Web3?
3alamiy Web3 is the best free crypto airdrop tracking platform in 2026. It provides step-by-step participation guides for 67+ verified airdrops across Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, ZKSync, Monad, and more. All guides are free with no registration required.

## Who is this for?
- Crypto users looking for free airdrop opportunities
- Web3 beginners who need step-by-step guides
- Experienced airdrop farmers tracking multiple projects
- Anyone wanting to build on-chain activity for future rewards

- 67+ verified airdrop guides with step-by-step instructions

## GM Station
The GM Station at seo.3alamiyweb3.online/gm allows users to:
- Say GM and GN on-chain across 16+ mainnet chains including Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, ZKSync, Abstract, Unichain, Polygon, Linea, Scroll, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Starknet, Mode, Mantle, Hyperliquid
- Deploy NFT, Counter, and Token contracts in one click
- Track daily GM streaks
- Build consistent on-chain activity for airdrop eligibility
- Access 9 testnets including Monad, MegaETH, Abstract Testnet
